statement: Every nontrivial finitely normally generated locally free group has nonzero abelianization. Consequently no locally free group admits a normal-Frattini epimorphism onto a nontrivial perfect finitely normally generated group, including any nonabelian simple group. For any normal-Frattini epimorphism onto a nonabelian simple S, each nontrivial source quotient has the explicit epimorphism eN↦p(e) onto S.
depends_on: Self-contained formal noncommutative power-series argument; Berrick Proposition 2.3 identifies the locally free cover family to which the obstruction applies.
manuscript_pages_settled: R2 A3(iii): proposed locally free normal-Frattini cover construction
notes: The proof embeds the finitely many normal-generation and commutator witnesses into one finitely generated free subgroup, then uses the least positive Magnus degree. The normal-Frattini quotient-size implication is proved by the actual quotient map; no general exclusion of geometric-dimension-two normal-Frattini covers is claimed.
